questions.stem: Which conclusion about urbanization in South does the 2017 data support?

options.text: The 2017 South data support population density as the explanation for the urbanization pattern.
options.misconception: mistakes density for the total number of residents

options.text: The 2017 South data support suburbanization as the explanation for the urbanization pattern.
options.misconception: treats any city growth as suburban expansion

options.text: The 2017 South data support urbanization as the explanation for the urbanization pattern.
The 2017 South data support demographic transition as the explanation for the urbanization pattern.
options.misconception: confuses a rural-urban shift with a vital-rate change

questions.explanation: The increasing share of a population living in cities. The 2017 data from the American South (58% versus 12%) fit this reading; the alternatives describe different mechanisms.
questions.hint: Consider which idea links the finding to wider society.
